effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.
qualifications: The exponent h(t) is finite and nonnegative.
There is a computable function T such that h(t) ≤ η max(t, 1) whenever t ≥ T(η), for each positive rational η.
The proof also permits the solver to receive the exact width and an optimal path decomposition, counted in the complete input length.

reader.label: Effective little-o bound in the treewidth

sources.locator: Theorem 6, logarithmic pathwidth. Treewidth is at most pathwidth, so an effective sublinear exponent in treewidth would yield an FPT algorithm for Clique.
Theorem 11, Independent Set parameterized by logarithmic treewidth. The supplied tree decomposition can be discarded for the unrestricted problem.

statement: Under FPT ≠ W[1], no deterministic algorithm decides Independent Set within the stated running time.
